title: Inorder Traversal (LNR)
question: What is inorder traversal? Write the recursive implementation in Java.
realWorldScenario: Inorder on BST produces sorted output — used to validate BST and to implement sorted iteration.

title: Preorder Traversal (NLR)
question: What is preorder traversal? When is it used? Write the recursive implementation.
realWorldScenario: Preorder serializes a tree structure — the root is first, so you can reconstruct from a preorder sequence.

title: Postorder Traversal (LRN)
question: What is postorder traversal? When is it typically used? Write the recursive implementation.
realWorldScenario: Postorder is used to delete a tree (children before parent) and to evaluate expression trees.

title: Inorder Traversal Iterative
question: How do you perform inorder traversal of a binary tree iteratively using a Stack?
seoKeywords: binary tree inorder without recursion java
realWorldScenario: Iterative traversal avoids stack overflow for very deep trees and is used in tree iterator implementations.

title: What Each Traversal Produces
question: For the same binary tree, compare the outputs of inorder, preorder, and postorder traversal.
searchIntent: inorder preorder postorder output java interview
realWorldScenario: An interviewer may show a tree and ask for the traversal order — being able to trace them mentally is essential.

title: Reconstruct Tree from Traversals
question: Can you reconstruct a unique binary tree from inorder + preorder traversal? What about inorder + postorder?
searchIntent: reconstruct tree preorder inorder java interview
realWorldScenario: Preorder gives the root; inorder splits into left and right subtrees. Recursively reconstruct both halves.

title: Morris Traversal — Concept
question: What is Morris traversal? What is its advantage over recursive and iterative traversal?
realWorldScenario: Morris traversal threads back-pointers temporarily for O(1) space inorder traversal — advanced interview question.
